rows.title: Settle
rows.text:
Sit upright in a firm chair, feet flat on the floor, hands resting on your thighs. Let your eyes close. Follow the square of the breath: in for four, hold for four, out for four, hold for four. With each out-breath let the day fall away: its errands, its voices, its hurry. Feel the weight of your body held by the chair and the floor. You are not going anywhere yet; you are simply arriving here.

When your breathing is slow and even, notice a faint light gathering in the darkness behind your closed eyes.

rows.title: The Temple of {from}
rows.text:
Around you a temple takes shape: the temple of {from}, {from_sphere}. Its walls glow {from_light}. Feel the floor beneath you and the air on your skin; notice the temperature and the quality of the silence.

Before you stand two pillars, one black and one white. Raise your hands and vibrate the divine name of this sphere, {god_name}, letting the sound fill the whole temple. Then call upon its archangel, {archangel}, and sense a vast, calm presence standing behind you, keeping the temple while you travel.

rows.title: The Veil
rows.text:
Between the pillars hangs a heavy curtain of {veil_colour}. Woven into it is the image of the trump {trump}: {trump_image}. Study it for a while. This picture is the doorway.

With your right hand trace the letter {letter} upon the curtain in bright {veil_colour} light, and vibrate its name: {letter}. The letter blazes, the image seems to breathe, and slowly the curtain parts. Beyond it a way of {path_colour} light leads on toward {to}.

rows.title: Onto the Path
rows.text:
Step through the veil. The curtain falls closed behind you, and you know you can return the way you came at any moment. The path beneath your feet is firm. This is the path of {letter}, whose name means {letter_meaning}, the way of {attribution}.

Walk slowly. Notice the light: its colour, its warmth. Notice the sounds, the smells, the texture of the ground. Do not hurry to make anything happen; let the path show itself to you.

rows.title: The Landscape
rows.text:
As you walk, the path opens into a landscape. {landscape}

Let the scene fill in by itself. If an image arises that does not seem to belong, test it: trace the letter {letter} before it and see whether it holds or fades. Keep only what holds.

rows.title: The Guardian of the Path
rows.text:
Further on, where the path narrows, the way is kept by {guardian}. This is the guardian of the path, the living presence of {trump}. Approach with respect. Trace the letter {letter} in the air and vibrate its name once more; a true guardian will stand firm or grow brighter, while a false image will waver and fade.

Greet the guardian and, if you wish, ask its name. Notice how it appears to you now: its colours, what it holds, how it moves, and how it regards you.

rows.title: The Teaching
rows.text:
Ask the guardian, simply and sincerely, what this path has to teach you. Then wait.

The answer may come as words, an image, a gesture, a feeling in the body, or a gift placed in your hands. Do not argue with it or try to shape it; receive it and remember it. When it is complete, give thanks.

rows.title: The Light of {to}
rows.text: Look past the guardian to where the path rises. Far ahead shines {to}, {to_sphere}, in a radiance of {to_light}. You are not to enter it now. Simply let its light fall on you, and feel what it is to stand on the way between {from} and {to}.

rows.title: Return
rows.text: Turn around and walk back the way you came, passing through the landscape again and noticing anything that has changed. Reach the curtain, step through it, and let it fall closed behind you. Trace the letter {letter} upon it once more to seal the way. You stand again in the temple of {from}.

rows.title: Closing
rows.text:
Give thanks to {archangel} for keeping the temple, and vibrate once more: {god_name}. Let the temple slowly fade until only the darkness behind your eyes remains.

Feel the chair beneath you and the weight of your body; feel your feet on the floor. Take a deeper breath, move your fingers and toes, and when you are ready, open your eyes.
